chapterInfo.content:
41
Ismael di Gedalia awu
1 # Yer 40.8; 2 Ah 25.25 Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no, Elisama ba Netania ba Ismael a ɔfiri ɔhene asefoɔ ne ɔhene atitire mu no, ne mmarima du a wɔka ne ho baa Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa, na wɔbɔɔ mu didii Mispa hɔ. 2#Yer 40.5 Ɛnna Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima du a wɔka ne ho no sɔre de nkrantɛ bobɔɔ Safan ba Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babel hene de no asi asase no so panin no kumm no. 3Na Yudafoɔ a wɔne ɔno Gedalia te Mispa no nyinaa ne Kaldeafoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn hɔ a wɔyɛ akofoɔ no nso, Ismael kunkumm wɔn.
4Na Gedalia kum akyiri nnanu a obiara nteeɛ no, 5#Lew 19.28 mmarima bi firi Sekem ne Silo ne Samaria bae, wɔyɛ aduɔwɔtwe, na wɔayiyi wɔn bɔdwesɛ asunsuane wɔn ntadeɛ mu abobɔ wɔn ho akam, na wɔkura aduane afɔdeɛ ne aduhwam sɛ wɔde reba AWURADE fie. 6Na Netania ba Ismael firi Mispa kɔhyiaa wɔn. Ɔrekorɔ no, na ɔresu, na ɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommra Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn. 7Na wɔduruu kuro no mu no, Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no kunkumm wɔn guu abura bi mu. 8Nanso wɔn mu mmarima du wɔ hɔ a wɔka kyerɛɛ Ismael sɛ: Nkum yɛn, na yɛwɔ akoradeɛ wɔ wiram, ayuo ne atokoɔ ne ngo ne ɛwoɔ. Ɛnna ɔgyaeeɛ, na wankum wɔn ampae wɔn nuanom no so.
9 # 1 Ah 15.16, 22 Nso abura a Ismael totoo mmarima a ɔkunkumm wɔn kaa Gedalia ho no afunu guu mu no ne deɛ Israelhene Baasa nti Ɔhene Asa tuiɛ no, ɛno na Netania ba Ismael de atɔfoɔ no hyɛɛ no ma. 10Ɛnna Ismael faa ɔman no nkaeɛ a wɔwɔ Mispa no nyinaa nnommum, ɔhene mmammaa ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔkaa Mispa a ankɔbeahene Nebusaradan de wɔn hyɛɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia nsa no nyinaa, Netania ba Ismael faa wɔn nnommum kɔe, sɛ ɔrekɔtwam akɔ Amonfoɔ nkyɛn.
Yudafoɔ pɛ sɛ anka wɔkɔ Misraim
11 # Yer 40.8, 13-16 Na Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa tee bɔne a Netania ba Ismael ayɛ no, 12#2 Sa 2.13 wɔfaa mmarima no nyinaa kɔɔ sɛ wɔne Netania ba Ismael rekɔko; na wɔkɔtoo no asukɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Gibeon no ho. 13Na nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka Ismael ho no nyinaa hunuu Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa no, wɔn ani gyee, 14na ɔman a Ismael faa wɔn nnommum firii Mispa no danedanee wɔn ho sanee wɔn akyiri baa Karea ba Yohanan nkyɛn. 15Na Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima baawɔtwe firii mu firii Yohanan anim, na wɔsii mu kɔɔ Amonfoɔ nkyɛn. 16Ɛnna Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa faa ɔman no nkaeɛ a ɔde wɔn sane firii Netania ba Ismael a ɔkumm Ahikam ba Gedalia no nkyɛn Mispa, na wɔfaa mmarima akofoɔ ne mmaa ne mmɔfra ne mpiafoɔ a ɔde wɔn sane firii Gibeon no, 17#2 Sa 19.37; Yer 43.7 na wɔsii mu kɔtenaa Kimham asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Betlehem nkyɛn mu, sɛ wɔrefa so akɔ Misraim 18afiri Kaldeafoɔ no anim, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro wɔn anim, sɛ Netania ba Ismael akum Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babel hene de no si asase no so panin no.

Na bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no, Elisama ba Netania ba Ismael a ɔfiri ɔhene asefoɔ ne ɔhene atitire mu no, ne mmarima du a wɔka ne ho baa Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa, na wɔbɔɔ mu didii Mispa hɔ. Ɛnna Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima du a wɔka ne ho no sɔre de nkrantɛ bobɔɔ Safan ba Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babel hene de no asi asase no so panin no kumm no. Na Yudafoɔ a wɔne ɔno Gedalia te Mispa no nyinaa ne Kaldeafoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn hɔ a wɔyɛ akofoɔ no nso, Ismael kunkumm wɔn.
Na Gedalia kum akyiri nnanu a obiara nteeɛ no, mmarima bi firi Sekem ne Silo ne Samaria bae, wɔyɛ aduɔwɔtwe, na wɔayiyi wɔn bɔdwesɛ asunsuane wɔn ntadeɛ mu abobɔ wɔn ho akam, na wɔkura aduane afɔdeɛ ne aduhwam sɛ wɔde reba AWURADE fie. Na Netania ba Ismael firi Mispa kɔhyiaa wɔn. Ɔrekorɔ no, na ɔresu, na ɔduruu wɔn nkyɛn no, ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Mommra Ahikam ba Gedalia nkyɛn. Na wɔduruu kuro no mu no, Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no kunkumm wɔn guu abura bi mu. Nanso wɔn mu mmarima du wɔ hɔ a wɔka kyerɛɛ Ismael sɛ: Nkum yɛn, na yɛwɔ akoradeɛ wɔ wiram, ayuo ne atokoɔ ne ngo ne ɛwoɔ. Ɛnna ɔgyaeeɛ, na wankum wɔn ampae wɔn nuanom no so.
Nso abura a Ismael totoo mmarima a ɔkunkumm wɔn kaa Gedalia ho no afunu guu mu no ne deɛ Israelhene Baasa nti Ɔhene Asa tuiɛ no, ɛno na Netania ba Ismael de atɔfoɔ no hyɛɛ no ma. Ɛnna Ismael faa ɔman no nkaeɛ a wɔwɔ Mispa no nyinaa nnommum, ɔhene mmammaa ne nkurɔfoɔ a wɔkaa Mispa a ankɔbeahene Nebusaradan de wɔn hyɛɛ Ahikam ba Gedalia nsa no nyinaa, Netania ba Ismael faa wɔn nnommum kɔe, sɛ ɔrekɔtwam akɔ Amonfoɔ nkyɛn.

Na Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no nyinaa tee bɔne a Netania ba Ismael ayɛ no, wɔfaa mmarima no nyinaa kɔɔ sɛ wɔne Netania ba Ismael rekɔko; na wɔkɔtoo no asukɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Gibeon no ho. Na nkurɔfoɔ a wɔka Ismael ho no nyinaa hunuu Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa no, wɔn ani gyee, na ɔman a Ismael faa wɔn nnommum firii Mispa no danedanee wɔn ho sanee wɔn akyiri baa Karea ba Yohanan nkyɛn. Na Netania ba Ismael ne mmarima baawɔtwe firii mu firii Yohanan anim, na wɔsii mu kɔɔ Amonfoɔ nkyɛn. Ɛnna Karea ba Yohanan ne dɔm asafohene a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa faa ɔman no nkaeɛ a ɔde wɔn sane firii Netania ba Ismael a ɔkumm Ahikam ba Gedalia no nkyɛn Mispa, na wɔfaa mmarima akofoɔ ne mmaa ne mmɔfra ne mpiafoɔ a ɔde wɔn sane firii Gibeon no, na wɔsii mu kɔtenaa Kimham asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Betlehem nkyɛn mu, sɛ wɔrefa so akɔ Misraim afiri Kaldeafoɔ no anim, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro wɔn anim, sɛ Netania ba Ismael akum Ahikam ba Gedalia a Babel hene de no si asase no so panin no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
